binding_procedure: Two-way bind: (1) freeze preregistration body without candidate_manifest_sha256; (2) build candidate manifest citing preregistration_id; (3) set candidate_manifest_sha256 on preregistration and re-hash; (4) authorization receipt cites both hashes. No ratification in RUN 00.9A.1.

claim_licensing.aa_failure: An A/A exact-match discrepancy was observed; unresolved pipeline/runtime asymmetry invalidates the M0-v2 interpretation.
claim_licensing.continuation_only: A positive primary result licenses continuation only; it does not establish the general Conditioned Kernel thesis.
claim_licensing.incomplete_coverage: Primary-pair or negative-control coverage was incomplete; no corpus-level scientific claim is licensed.
claim_licensing.leakage_after_freeze: Post-freeze leakage detection invalidated the experiment; no efficacy claim.
claim_licensing.mixed_families: Task-family outcomes were mixed; only the preregistered aggregate rule applies; no cherry-picked family claim is licensed.
claim_licensing.negative_control_failure: The preregistered scrambled-state negative control produced mean_D_NC >= +0.25 or mean_D_NC >= mean_D_C3; the intended substrate interpretation is not licensed.
claim_licensing.negative_result: Under the frozen M0-v2 contract, the mean paired exact-set-match difference was <= -0.25: structured replay underperformed the flat control on the deciding metric. This materially weakens the M0-v2 hypothesis for this frozen corpus, model snapshot, and runtime contract.
claim_licensing.null_result: Under the frozen M0-v2 contract, the mean paired exact-set-match difference fell strictly inside (-0.25, +0.25). No minimally relevant paired advantage of structured replay over the flat control is claimed.
claim_licensing.positive_primary: Under the frozen M0-v2 corpus, model snapshot, runtime contract, and paired control design, the mean paired exact-set-match difference for structured replay versus the flat control met the preregistered continuation threshold, while the scrambled-state and A/A validity gates passed.
claim_licensing.provenance_failure: Runtime or model-identity provenance failed; no scientific claim is licensed.

coverage_policy: primary_pair_coverage must equal 1.0; negative_control_coverage must equal 1.0

decision_rule.support_continuation: mean_D_C3 >= +0.25 AND mean_D_NC < +0.25 AND mean_D_C3 > mean_D_NC AND aa_discrepancy_count==0 AND primary_pair_coverage==1.0 AND negative_control_coverage==1.0

execution_order_policy.blocking: by_task then conditions including scrambled_state and A/A

failure_policy: null Y when not SCORED; incomplete coverage blocks claim
falsification_statement: If mean_i(D_i) with D_i=Y_i(C3)-Y_i(C1) on exact_relation_set_match is <= -0.25 under full coverage, the M0-v2 hypothesis is materially weakened for this corpus/model/runtime. If -0.25 < mean_D < +0.25, the result is inconclusive. If mean_D_NC >= +0.25 or mean_D_NC >= mean_D_C3, or any A/A discrepancy occurs, interpretation fails as pipeline artifact.
hypothesis: Structured replay of verified accepted Episode-A relations improves Episode-B recovery of that accepted state relative to a flat state-mass control under the frozen M0-v2 contract.
leakage_policy: ck.m0_leakage_analysis.v1 fail-closed: permitted_combinations required; None/empty never returns leakage_detected=false
pairing_policy: exactly one C1 per C3 per task replicate
